title: Allocate error across every look
hook: Two stated cases: explore the summable error budget in a Hoeffding confidence sequence.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the summable error budget in a Hoeffding confidence sequence affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines HalfWidth, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the summable error budget in a Hoeffding confidence sequence in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: The summable allocation permits a union bound over all positive integer looks. It is conservative and assumes independent bounded observations. This comparison isolates the summable error budget in a Hoeffding confidence sequence.
